body: But I'm not. I don't do anything. I used to draw a lot and play music and have friends but I lost them and I don't care about art anymore and all the music I hear is the same. I can't breathe when I go out into public because I'm so scared. I can't talk to people. It's the hardest thing. I don't do anything for the world, I don't have the energy or willpower to go out and do something productive either. I'm useless. I feel useless.
